description: Refactor PR renames aws_dynamodb_table.orders to orders_table without a moved block (Terraform destroys the live orders table and creates an empty one with the same name) and renames the exports bucket with a correct moved block (no-op apart from the new tag). Noise: an Owner default tag on every resource, a new giftcards service queue/log group/parameter, the IAM policy re-rendered with the new table ARN.

material.why: The resource was renamed without a moved block, so Terraform destroys the production orders table and creates a new empty table with the same name: every order item is gone, recoverable only by restoring the PITR system backup into a new table. The create may also fail at apply with ResourceInUseException if it runs before the delete finishes, leaving no table at all.
